description: Measurement schema tolerance profile v1.0.0: thresholds for the AGREE/MINOR_DIFF/MAJOR_DIFF classification and accuracy gates. See design section 21.2 and AT-16.

rows.name: accuracyGate
rows.description: Tolerance threshold for measuring median accuracy during QA and Kit release.

rows.name: accuracyGateP95
rows.description: Tolerance threshold for measuring P95 accuracy during QA.

rows.name: agree
rows.description: Threshold for classifying a client-server measurement pair as AGREE. The per-dimension difference must be <= tol(server, agree).

rows.name: minor
rows.description: Threshold for classifying a pair as MINOR_DIFF. MAJOR_DIFF is assigned if the difference exceeds tol(server, minor).

notes.algorithm: tol(ref, profile) = max(floorM, relFrac * ref, min(sigmaK * combinedSigma, sigmaCapM))
notes.combinedSigma: sqrt(sigmaServer^2 + sigmaClient^2); if sigmaK is null, the sigma term is omitted from max()
notes.comparison: Values are compared in metres rounded to 1e-5 with <=
notes.association: See design section 21.2 for association rules (seeded, IoU, geometric, dimension-only)
notes.versioning: Profile versions are immutable. A threshold retune publishes a new version (e.g. 1.1.0), never edits 1.0.0. Every measurement_comparison row stores tolerance_profile_version.
